text:
Evan Bouchard has 10 goals in 18 games, the fastest any defenceman in Oilers history has reached 10, per Sportsnet. It took him all 82 games to score 21 last season. He's logging 25.78 minutes a night, has points in six straight games, and ranks 12th of 504 skaters in our wins added (how much his goals moved Edmonton's chances of winning).

Now the honest part. Those 10 goals came on 3.5 expected goals, the quality of his own shots, and he's shooting 20% after 10% last season. His shot hasn't really changed (0.46 expected goals per 60, against 0.44 last season); the puck is just going in. Edmonton has also scored 21.1 more goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice, and that won't hold either.

What will hold is the rest. Evolving-Hockey had him fifth among 215 defensemen in wins above replacement last season, built on even-strength offense, with the caveat that he plays beside strong teammates. Our range has him at 114 points over the full season (99 to 129) even with the goals cooling. Expect fewer goals and the same steady flow of setups.
headline: Bouchard's goals are a hot streak, the rest is real
